test_name: Issue 578: which faces defeaturing will accept::foreignFaceInMixedRequestFails

differences: EXPECTED_DIVERGENCE (#578): the bridge fails a request that names a face this shape does not have, in either order, and returns nil. The kernel ignores the foreign face (BRepAlgoAPI_Defeaturing.hxx: faces that do not belong are ignored), so [fillet, foreign] and [foreign, fillet] both succeed and remove the real face, 6 faces, with no warning: the silent half-success the refusal exists to prevent.
[fillet] alone agrees (6 faces, volume 7999.9999999999982) and [foreign] alone agrees (no shape: the kernel has nothing to remove).

source: Same quantities on both sides, per request: whether a shape came back, its face count and its volume, for the 20 mm box with one edge filleted (7 faces, volume 7982.8318530717943). Bridge values are what the test observed, read from a temporary print of the shape each request returned (run once and reverted, not committed; volume at %.17g). Kernel values are from Scripts/repro/766-modeling-issue578-defeature-face-membership/transcript-evidence-fix.txt, made by probe-evidence-fix.mm, which hands BRepAlgoAPI_Defeaturing (SetShape, AddFacesToRemove, Build; a result only when IsDone and the shape is not null, as occtDefeaturePerform) the faces each request explodes to, the way the bridge would with its #578 membership check absent. Requests: the fillet face, the fillet face with a face of an 11 mm box, the two in the other order, and the foreign face alone.

test_name: Issue 578: which faces defeaturing will accept::mixedCarrierFails

differences: EXPECTED_DIVERGENCE (#578): the bridge explodes each carrier and fails the call when any face it contributes is not this shape's, so a compound of the fillet face and a foreign face returns nil. The kernel explodes the same compound, ignores the foreign face and removes the real one (6 faces).
compound(fillet) agrees, and equals the bare fillet face's removal (6 faces, volume 7999.9999999999982).

test_name: Issue 578: which faces defeaturing will accept::membershipIsIdentityNotGeometry

[twin fillet] alone agrees (no shape: the kernel finds no face of this shape to remove) and [fillet] agrees (6 faces, volume 7999.9999999999982).
